measurements.location_context: Mars surface, Curiosity rover location (Gale Crater)
measurements.interpretation: The daily mean absorbed dose rate measured by RAD on 11 September 2017 (17.87 µGy/hour) was about 2.3 times the 6 September comparison day (7.68 µGy/hour). These are measurements at one rover location; they are not a general Mars dose and not a crew health limit.
measurements.data_note: Correction: the supplied pack listed 7.68 on 2017-09-10 and 17.87 on 2017-09-12. Re-checking the RadLab API showed those two daily means belong to 2017-09-06 (n=83) and 2017-09-11 (n=129). 2017-09-10 averages about 8.0 and 2017-09-12 falls from about 17.5 to 9.7. The event period 10-12 September is kept as context.
